text.content: A Look at this picture for two minutes. What was happening when it started to rain?
Try to remember as many details as you can.
B Cover the picture. Ask the questions and answer with the information
Where was the couple sitting when the rain started? What were they doing?
What was the police officer holding? What was she wearing?
What was the name of the café? What was on the café table?
What was the waiter holding? Where was he standing?
What was the young boy holding? What was he watching on TV?
What was the taxi driver doing? What was the name of the cab company?
C @AEME check your answers. How many answers did you remember correctly?
